title: Removing characteristic powers from roots of unity
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] of positive characteristic $p$, with $p$ prime. For every integer $a\ge0$, integer $m\ge1$, and unit $z\in k^\times$, $$z^{p^a m}=1\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad z^m=1.$$ Equivalently, the subgroups $\mu_{p^a m}(k)=\{z\in k^\times:z^{p^a m}=1\}$ and $\mu_m(k)=\{z\in k^\times:z^m=1\}$ are equal.
